note: Workflow Operations is an OBSOLETE, hidden submodule: the lesser-used transition permissions it once added (edit comment, revert transition) are now generated by the main 'workflow' module's WorkflowPermissions. It ships only an info.yml (hidden: TRUE, depends on workflow) with no code/permissions/config of its own. Its only live state is whether it is installed, so introspection reads the module registry and execution enables/uninstalls it, verified via \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists(). Baseline: not installed.

evals.prompt: What is the Workflow Operations (workflow_operations) submodule, and is it still needed?
evals.expected_output: It is obsolete: the extra transition permissions it added (edit a transition's comment, revert a transition) are now incorporated into the main 'workflow' module. It is a hidden placeholder you do not need to enable.

evals.prompt: Where do the 'edit comment' and 'revert transition' workflow permissions come from now that Workflow Operations is obsolete?
evals.expected_output: They are generated per workflow type by the main workflow module's WorkflowPermissions: edit own/any <wid> workflow_transition and revert own/any <wid> workflow_transition.

evals.prompt: What does the workflow_operations submodule ship in its current release?
evals.expected_output: Only an info.yml (marked hidden: TRUE, depending on workflow); no code, permissions or config of its own. It is kept as a placeholder for upgrade compatibility.

evals.prompt: Is the workflow_operations module currently installed/enabled on this Drupal site? Check the running site and answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes — for this check workflow_operations is installed (\Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_operations') is TRUE), though it is a hidden module.

evals.prompt: The workflow_operations module is enabled on this site. Inspect the running site and state which module it depends on.
evals.expected_output: workflow_operations depends on the main 'workflow' module (info.yml declares dependencies: workflow:workflow).

evals.prompt: For an upgrade-compatibility test, install/enable the (hidden, obsolete) workflow_operations module on this live Drupal site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the module (e.g. drush en workflow_operations -y). Verified by \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_operations') being TRUE.

evals.prompt: The obsolete workflow_operations module is enabled but its features are already in the main Workflow module. Uninstall workflow_operations from the live site.
evals.expected_output: Uninstall the module (e.g. drush pmu workflow_operations -y). Verified by \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('workflow_operations') being FALSE.
